title: C++ Exceptions for Smaller Firmware - Khalil Estell - CppCon 2024
summary: Khalil Estell's CppCon 2024 talk argues C++ exceptions can reduce binary size in firmware. He digs into how exceptions work and how to shrink their code footprint on embedded platforms.
why: Pointed to as the in-depth talk on exception mechanics and code size for embedded C++.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages
